script: Export Processing Zones Authority, BEPZA: eight point four billion dollars.
That's seventeen and a half percent of Bangladesh's exports last fiscal year.
BEPZA runs eight EPZs: ready plots, power, one-stop service.
Investors lease space there; check eligibility with BEPZA first.
Then show your products on Exportain, so buyers abroad find you.
